alerts.title: [BUG BOUNTY] Medium: prover-wasm proving-key loads accept trailing bytes (prove_withdrawal_v2 / prove_transfer_v2 / prove_transact)
alerts.escrow_note: reporter settlement wallet only; venue pays post-merge from treasury; no per-ticket escrow contract
alerts.excerpt: ## Summary Trailing-byte acceptance in all three client-side proving-key loads in `paraloom-prover-wasm` (in Stage-1 scope: client proof generation). Each calls `ProvingKey::<Bn254>::deserialize_compressed(proving_key)` on the full input slice without verifying the cursor is exhausted, so a corrupted or concatenated proving-key file is silently accepted at prove time. ## Root Cause & Exact File/Line References - `paraloom-prover-wasm/src/lib.rs:220` (`prove_withdrawal_v2`): `let pk = ProvingKey::<Bn254>::deserialize_compressed(proving_key)` — no trailing-byte check. - `paraloom-prover-wasm/src
